lq.ANSWER: The Body is an instrument of the Self because the Self uses the Body for behaviour with human beings and work with the rest of nature. The Self is central to human existence, because it is the Self that wants to live with continuous happiness. The Body does not decide its own use; the decision regarding the fulfilment of the Body’s needs and the use of the Body is made by the Self. The Body requires physical facility for nurturing, protection and right utilisation. The transaction between the Self and Body is through information: the Self gives instructions to the Body, and the Body gives sensations to the Self. Therefore, keeping the Body healthy is important, but the purpose of the Body is to act as a useful instrument for the Self to live in harmony at all levels.
lq.QUESTION_DESC: Explain the statement: “The Body is an instrument of the Self.”
